purpose: collect public option-trade prints near the daily decision time as an observed execution-price reference

source.pagination: recursively bisect a time range when has_more is true; deduplicate only by trade_id

selection_contract.moneyness: nearest strike to the contemporaneous index price, requiring at least one call and put print
selection_contract.price_reference: observed trade price; directional fill scenarios apply the independently calibrated Tardis half-spread

interpretation_limits: a third-party print is an observed executed price, not a guarantee that our order could fill at that price or size
the tape does not expose contemporaneous bid/ask depth or queue position
missing call or put prints inside the frozen window are coverage failures and are not interpolated
